data.narrative:
Cache Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Arpit Dwivedi that has raised $8.5M to date. The valuation universe for Climate & Energy comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—zero datapoints met filtering criteria—precluding a reliable peer-median analysis.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and provides the primary valuation signal. Using the $8.5M total raised as a value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the subsequent stage yields an implied valuation of $21M. This represents a modest mark-up consistent with early-stage venture capital progression expectations.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $18M to $24M, with a median of $21M. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow peer benchmarking—any valuation refinement would require additional same-stage or similar-tier private comparables in climate tech—and dependence on the stage-progression multiplier as a proxy for market conditions. The range should be treated as directional pending further market data or milestone achievement.
